lead: A private, local-first reader for manga, comics, and EPUB novels. Organize your collection, enjoy comfortable reading, and keep your books on your device.

featuresTitle: Everything you need to settle in and read.
features: Keep manga, comics, and novels together, organized into Series and Volumes.
Settle into novels with adjustable fonts, a table of contents, and reading progress restoration.
Choose interactive page turns or continuous vertical scrolling for your comics.
Keep selected books in a separate library protected by device authentication.
Link a folder through Files or transfer books from your computer over local Wi-Fi.
Read imported books offline. No account required. No developer-hosted cloud library.
soonReading: Coming in 1.2.0: improved EPUB rendering, typography and font settings, smoother interactive comic page turns, and more reliable reading progress restoration on iPhone and iPad.

languagesText: The app supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
proEyebrow: For readers with more to keep
proText: Free: create up to 3 Series and keep adding Volumes to existing Series. Panelune Pro removes the Series limit.
proPrice: See your local price in the app.
formats: Read EPUB, PDF, and supported comic archives.
disclaimer: Panelune does not provide or distribute books. Import only content that you have the right to use.
